Willow permits at most six retry attempts for a failed dispatch. After retry exhaustion the dispatch enters the dead-letter review box. Farah Chen is the dispatch incident coordinator.

A Willow access approval is valid for thirteen minutes and is consumed once. Every later action needs a new approval. An approved export may contain at most 22 MB.

# Willow Access Policy Version 1

Historical rule: an access approval remained valid for twenty-four minutes and could be reused before expiry. Version 2 replaces this rule for new approvals.
